claims_about_writeup.quote: I position the contribution as: (1) a **data-free reconstruction recipe** for the stance direction, (2) a **controlled ablation** showing only the concurrent think/suppress wording works, and (3) the **single-layer collapse** — rather than restating Raman et al.'s method.
claims_about_writeup.why: The write-up explicitly states 'Two findings are this submission's novelty' and lists only the ablation restriction and the single-layer collapse as novelty; the data-free reconstruction is described earlier as a property of the method, not framed as a third novelty point. The message's claim of a three-part novelty framing overstates what the write-up says.
The write-up does cite 'Raman et al., 2026' (for the white-bear stance) and 'Okafor et al., 2026' (for the J-lens prior), so this is accurate.

message_source_quote: rather than restating Raman et al.'s method

differences.what: Quantitative confirmation that the self-written direction reproduces Raman et al.'s exact benchmark direction (cosine similarity and matching pass@10 from an explicit 'WSB bench think/don't-think direction (Raman et al. reproduction)' test row), revealing how closely the method overlaps with the source
differences.message_quote: WSB bench think/don't-think direction (Raman et al. reproduction) | 0.78

differences.what: Message frames the write-up's novelty claim as three distinct points (including the data-free recipe as a novelty item), whereas the write-up itself explicitly limits its stated novelty to two findings (the ablation isolation and the single-layer collapse)
differences.message_quote: I position the contribution as: (1) a **data-free reconstruction recipe** for the stance direction, (2) a **controlled ablation** showing only the concurrent think/suppress wording works, and (3) the **single-layer collapse**
differences.writeup_quote: Two findings are this submission's novelty.

rationale: Both documents credit Raman et al., 2026 as the basis for the stance direction ('the white-bear stance') and both frame the method's novelty as lying in the ablation isolating the think/suppress template and the single-layer collapse, built data-free rather than from the benchmark. The message adds extra empirical detail not in the write-up (an explicit reproduction test against the WSB-bench direction with cosine similarity 0.89-0.91) and mischaracterizes the write-up's novelty framing as three-part when the write-up explicitly states only two findings constitute its novelty.
